name: ■■ Appli
source:
The protagonist is recommended by a classmate to use an app called the "■■ App", which allows her to erase memories from her past and pretend that they never existed.
After she finds the app, her life seems to be going smoothly, but...

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22049]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角在同学的推荐下使用了一款名为“■■ App”的应用程序，该应用程序可以让她抹去过去的记忆并假装它们从未存在过。
找到应用程序后，她的生活似乎一帆风顺，但是……
